newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones fell 51.18 points to 6,549.48 PLDT's ADR fell $0.25 to $51 3/8.
* On Wednesday, the peso weakened to 26.323 to a U.S. dollar from 26.304.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,206.99, up 11.52.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was down at 10.53125 pct from 10.5625 pct.

* The Department of Energy says it will seek the approval of President Fidel Ramos for the full deregulation of the oil industry by mid-February as the one billion peso Oil Price Stabilisation Fund will be depleted before March. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
* Philippine Times Journal says Fortune Cement Corp expects net income to reach 1.25 billion pesos this year, a 245 percent growth from 510 million pesos estimated profits in 1996.
* Times Journal says Global Equities Inc has obtained approval of the Securities and Exchange Commission to set up its own wholly-owned subsidiary to operate an export park.

* Today says the Philippines managed to post a record-high $4.2 billion balance of payments (BOP) surplus as of end-1996 over end-1995 surplus of $645 million quoting preliminary data released by the Central Bank.

* Malaya newspaper says Finance Minister Roberto de Ocampo will make sure that oil deregulation and tax reforms will be in place before June this year to ensure the country will be able to exit from the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
